text:
No thermal detections intersecting ASSET-F14 were reported for October 13–November 12, 2026. However, I cannot confirm that all sensors had coverage for the full period: VIIRS S-NPP data were unavailable for November 2–6.

VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21, and MODIS were reported as covered throughout the period. Zero reported detections does not rule out undetected thermal activity.
